description: Reload all process JSON files from the named plugin's knowledge base and update the live process registry. Performs full discovery rebuild after applying changes. Use plugin_name='ananta' for platform service interfaces.
embedding_description: Bulk-reload every process a plugin owns in one sweep after editing or adding several of its JSON files, rebuilding all of that plugin's live registry entries at once without a restart. Takes only plugin_name and needs no process_key, refreshing the whole plugin's entire process surface together; pass 'ananta' for platform service interfaces. Use after a batch of process JSON edits.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Count of updated processes and their process keys
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reloading process definitions from knowledge base JSON files
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: FileNotFoundError: plugin knowledge base directory not found. ValueError: JSON validation failed (missing process_key or field mismatch). RuntimeError: orchestrator not available for registry update.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify the plugin name is correct and the knowledge base directory contains valid process JSON files.
